name: Berjaya Corporation Berhad
summary: Berjaya Corporation Berhad provides consumer marketing, direct selling, and retailing services. It invests in, develops, manages, and rents properties; operates hotels, resorts, vacation timeshare, recreation and golf clubs, booking center, parking facilities, private university college, franchises restaurants, cafes, healthcare platform, and travel and tour agencies; retails food and beverage; produces, maintains, repairs, and trades in motor vehicles, as well as offers after sale services; and produces and supplies potable water.
